app_fee.value: No central application fee is stated. The eight faculties set the doctoral admission rules.
app_fee.quote: The eight faculties of Universität Hamburg are in charge of the doctoral application and admissions procedure.

fee_waiver.value: No central application fee or fee waiver is stated, because the faculties set the doctoral admission rules.
fee_waiver.quote: The eight faculties of Universität Hamburg are in charge of the doctoral application and admissions procedure.

gre_general.value: No GRE rule is stated on the central page; each faculty sets its own doctoral admission rules.
gre_general.quote: The eight faculties of Universität Hamburg are in charge of the doctoral application and admissions procedure.

toefl_min.value: No central TOEFL minimum is stated; the six MIN departments say no language test is required (see their program records).
toefl_min.quote: The eight faculties of Universität Hamburg are in charge of the doctoral application and admissions procedure.

ielts_min.value: No central IELTS minimum is stated; the six MIN departments say no language test is required (see their program records).
ielts_min.quote: The eight faculties of Universität Hamburg are in charge of the doctoral application and admissions procedure.

english_waiver.value: No central English-test rule for Indian degrees is stated; the MIN departments require no English test at all (see their program records).
english_waiver.quote: The eight faculties of Universität Hamburg are in charge of the doctoral application and admissions procedure.

notes: Doctoral admission is decided by each of the eight faculties under its own doctoral regulations, so there is no university-wide fee, GRE or English rule. The central page lists no engineering faculty; the MIN Faculty covers the natural sciences, informatics and mathematics. The Faculty of Medicine (UKE) runs a PhD programme for non-medical students with its own admission rules.
